ai.title: Fix discoverProjectFiles path resolution
ai.summary: discoverProjectFiles now joins relative paths with cwd before reading files. Previous logic used raw relative paths from getAllFilePaths, causing fs.readFileSync failures. Error handling moved inside the map loop to catch individual file issues without aborting discovery. Affects sdk/src/run-state.ts.

eli5.text: When the software scans your project folder to find files, it now correctly combines each file's name with your project's location before trying to read it. Previously, it passed the relative file name alone, which caused read failures on some setups. You would notice fewer warnings about failed file reads, and individual unreadable files no longer abort the entire scan.

ai.title: Add eval-planner subagent and reorder tool descriptions prompt
ai.summary: New `evals/subagents/eval-planner.ts` subagent introduced to run implementation planner evaluations against cloned repositories. `backend/src/tools/prompts.ts` modified to place tool descriptions after the critical instruction block. `diff` dependency added to `evals/package.json` to support file state comparison.

eli5.text: A new automated assistant was added that can independently test the system's planning capabilities by cloning repositories, running evaluations, and comparing file states before and after. At the same time, the order of instructions given to the system was changed so that a critical rule about which tools are available now appears before the descriptions of each tool. If you looked at the system's behavior, you would notice that the new assistant can dynamically load and test different planning agents, and that the main system now receives its tool-access rules earlier in its setup. The change is internal and affects how the evaluation and planning workflows operate behind the scenes.

ai.title: Flush last text chunk as print mode event
ai.summary: xml-stream-parser.ts now yields buffer content as a text StreamChunk upon stream completion. This ensures the final text segment is emitted and processed via onResponseChunk when forceFlush is true. The extractToolsFromBufferAndProcess function was converted to a generator to support this yield. Internal backend streaming logic only.

eli5.text: When the assistant finishes a response, the final piece of text that was being assembled behind the scenes is now delivered to you the same way every other sentence of that response is delivered instead of being dropped. This only affects how your app receives streamed replies, so if you were watching for each chunk of text as it arrived, you may have seen the last line vanish entirely from your end.

ai.title: eval-planner loads local agents dynamically
ai.summary: eval-planner now accepts agentId and loads all agents from .agents via loadLocalAgents instead of hardcoding implementation-planner. Judge model switched from x-ai/grok-4-fast to openai/gpt-5. Affects evals/subagents/eval-planner.ts. Requires agentId param in evalPlannerAgent calls.

eli5.text: The system that runs code evaluation tests no longer always uses the same planning tool; it now picks which one based on a label you pass in, so different tests can use different helpers loaded from a local folder. The part that grades how good the plan looks switched to a newer model from the same company that made ChatGPT. This is internal test infrastructure, so unless you run these tests yourself you won't see anything change in your day-to-day use; it just makes the test process more flexible and slightly smarter. The new label requirement means anyone writing or running these tests now has to specify which planning tool they want to use instead of it being assumed.

ai.title: Remove direct Gemini models from core constants and backend
ai.summary: The `geminiModels` object and associated types (`GeminiModel`) were removed from `common/src/old-constants.ts`, eliminating direct Gemini model IDs (`gemini-2.5-flash-preview-05-20`, etc.) from the core model registry. Backend routing in `backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts` and cost tracking in `backend/src/llm-apis/message-cost-tracker.ts` no longer handle these models, and prompt logic in `.agents/prompts/` now relies exclusively on `openrouter_gemini2_5_*` aliases. This enforces a single provider path for Gemini models via OpenRouter, removing direct Google AI SDK integration and associated thinking config logic from `backend/src/prompt-agent-stream.ts`.

eli5.text: The assistant no longer talks to Google's Gemini models through Google's own system, and instead goes through a service called OpenRouter. If you use the assistant, you won't see any change in how it works, but behind the scenes, it routes those same Gemini models through a single, different connection. This means the way it keeps track of costs and settings for those models is now handled in one place instead of two.

ai.title: eval-planner checkout previous commit
ai.summary: eval-planner adds checkoutPrevious flag to withTestRepo, enabling git checkout of parent commit via getPreviousCommitSha. evalPlannerAgent now passes checkoutPrevious: true, shifting evaluation baseline to pre-change state. Judge agent model updated from x-ai/grok-4-fast:free to x-ai/grok-4-fast. Event logging includes agent IDs for implementationPlannerAgent and eval-judge.

eli5.text: The automated quality-checking tool that tests code changes now rewinds the project to the state just before the change before running its evaluation, instead of testing right at the change point itself. This means the baseline it compares against is the clean, pre-edit version of the project, making it easier to isolate what the change actually did. If you watched the logs, you'd see it checking out the previous version of the code and the agent names (implementationPlannerAgent and eval-judge) appear alongside each event it records, whereas the judge model itself switched from the free-tier version to the standard one.

ai.title: Extract withTestRepo to test-repo-utils
ai.summary: Refactored `evals/subagents/eval-planner.ts` by moving `withTestRepo` and `getPreviousCommitSha` into new file `evals/subagents/test-repo-utils.ts`. Planner now imports these utilities instead of defining them locally. Internal change with no user-facing behavior impact.

eli5.text: Behind the scenes, the engineers moved some helper code that sets up temporary test repositories into its own dedicated file, making it easier to reuse across different parts of their internal tooling. Users would notice nothing different since this is purely an internal cleanup with no impact on functionality or performance.

ai.title: Refactor extractToolsFromBufferAndProcess to non-generator
ai.summary: Changed extractToolsFromBufferAndProcess from generator to void function. Directly calls onResponseChunk and clears buffer on flush. Scope: backend/src/xml-stream-parser.ts. Removes redundant yield and chunk object creation.

eli5.text: The system now handles incoming text and tool calls in a simpler, more direct way behind the scenes, so the parts that process what the assistant says no longer pause and resume repeatedly. You won't notice this as a user since it's an internal cleanup, but it makes the code easier to maintain and slightly less error-prone.

ai.title: Unify error serialization with getErrorObject
ai.summary: errorToObject removed from common/src/util/object.ts; all callers migrated to getErrorObject in common/src/util/error.ts. getErrorObject now handles Error instances and plain values, returning name, message, and stack. common/src/util/error.ts adds ErrorOr, Success, and Failure result types plus success/failure helpers. Scope covers backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts, backend/src/util/messages.ts, backend/src/util/simplify-tool-results.ts, npm-app/src/utils/changes.ts, and evals/git-evals/run-git-evals.ts.

eli5.text: When something goes wrong behind the scenes, the logs now show a cleaner, consistent snapshot of each error, its name, message, and where it happened, instead of copying over extra technical details that could clutter or repeat. If you happen to look at the error logs, you'll see the same simple format everywhere, because the old error-gathering helper was removed and everything switched over to the single, centralized one. This is already live for anyone reading the logs, and it doesn't change how often or when errors happen, just how they're recorded.

ai.title: New Decomposing Planner agent definition
ai.summary: Added .agents/decomposing-planner/decomposing-planner.ts defining a SecretAgent that decomposes tasks into 3-5 subtasks, spawns parallel implementation-planner agents, and synthesizes a unified plan. Uses anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5 with tools spawn_agents and read_files, and spawnable agents file-explorer and implementation-planner. Internal agent infrastructure addition.

eli5.text: An internal planning tool now uses a specialized helper that breaks big tasks into smaller pieces and assigns them to other helpers at the same time, then combines their work into one plan. If you looked, you would see a new configuration file that tells the system how to run this process, but it only affects how the company's internal tools are built, not anything you directly interact with.

ai.title: Retry generating output schema if errors
ai.summary: Added `hasRetriedOutputSchema` flag to retry loop when required output is missing. Injects system message forcing `set_output` usage and resets `shouldEndTurn` to continue execution. Scope limited to backend agent step logic in `run-agent-step.ts`. Prevents premature termination on schema violations.

eli5.text: The assistant sometimes ended its turn without providing a required result, causing it to appear finished when it hadn't actually given you the information it was supposed to produce. Now, if the assistant finishes without setting that required output, the system quietly notices and sends the assistant a reminder message instructing it to use the 'set_output' command, then keeps running instead of stopping. You wouldn't see the reminder directly, but you'd notice that the assistant no longer stops prematurely when one of its intermediate steps fails to produce the required output. This only applies to assistants that are configured to require a specific output format, and the fix is now live in the backend agent logic.
